Certainly! Below is a simple application for resignation in a formal format. This template is designed to be professional and secure, suitable for use in a private, air-gapped environment.

---

**Application for Resignation**

**Name:** [Your Full Name]

**Position:** [Your Current Position]

**Department:** [Your Department]

**Date:** [Date of Resignation]

---

**To Whom It May Concern:**

I, [Your Full Name], hereby formally apply to resign from my position as [Your Current Position] in [Your Department] at [Company Name]. I have been employed with [Company Name] since [Start Date] and have had the opportunity to contribute to the success of the organization.

I have thoroughly enjoyed my time at [Company Name] and have learned a great deal about the company's culture and values. However, I have decided to pursue new opportunities that align better with my career goals and personal aspirations.

I would like to thank [Company Name] for the support and opportunities I have had during my tenure. I am grateful for the training and development I have received and for the chance to work with such a talented and supportive team.

I am confident that my skills and experience will continue to be valuable to [Company Name] and am eager to continue contributing to the success of the organization.

I will work with my direct supervisor to ensure a smooth transition and to provide any necessary assistance in the process of my resignation.

Thank you for considering my application for resignation.

Sincerely,

[Your Full Name]

---

**Note:** This application should be kept in a secure, air-gapped environment to ensure its confidentiality.
